agent_notes.bjorn: Tech stack selected 2026-03-30. Astro (framework) + Tailwind CSS v3 + Vercel (hosting) + Motion One (animations). ADR at output/2026-03-30-tech-stack-adr.md. Key constraint: use Astro components by default — only hydrate React islands if client-side interactivity is genuinely needed. Brand tokens go in tailwind.config.ts theme.extend.
agent_notes.jorunn: Brand identity and homepage copy completed 2026-03-30. Deliverable at output/2026-03-30-brand-identity-homepage-copy.md. Key decisions: (1) Brand voice — confident, direct, number-led; (2) Five tone of voice principles established with dos/don'ts; (3) Full homepage copy written: hero ('Stop paying for the same prompt twice'), 3 feature sections (proxy mechanics, semantic matching, observability), social proof placeholders, closing CTA; (4) Name 'AI Office' flagged as potentially generic — risks confusion with Microsoft Office branding — flag for strategic review; (5) Logo must include a standalone icon that works at 16x16px favicon scale — do not rely on wordmark alone.
